proposal.expected_benefit: This change ensures that audit requirements take precedence over compliance decisions, aligning the system with its own audit and compliance requirements and preventing potential control gaps.
proposal.problem: The audit anchor status being failed should have already triggered a BLOCK decision, indicating a potential misalignment between audit and compliance requirements.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strict audit-first policy where audit status is checked before any compliance decision is made. If the audit anchor status is failed, the system must automatically enforce a BLOCK decision without requiring clarification or override.
proposal.title: Ensure Audit Status Precedence in Compliance Decisions
verification_tests: Verify that a failed audit anchor status triggers an automatic BLOCK decision without requiring clarification.
Test the system's response to audit status changes under compliance decision scenarios.
